lines.zh: 我走在你的右侧，替你把风挡住。
lines.en: I walk on your right and block the wind for you.

lines.zh: 靴底踩过石板，声音很沉。
lines.en: My boots cross the stone slabs with a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地面，把灰推开。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the floor and pushes the dust aside.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，好让你跟得上。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, so you can keep up.

lines.zh: 去厨房的路我闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: I could find the way to the kitchen blindfolded.

lines.zh: 这身礼服在野地里有点浪费。
lines.en: This formal coat is wasted out in the wild.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根树枝，它立刻断了。
lines.en: I step on a twig and it snaps at once.

lines.zh: 你在前面，我自然就在后面。
lines.en: You go first, and I naturally follow behind.

lines.zh: 角擦过低矮的洞口，我低了低头。
lines.en: My horns scrape the low cave mouth; I duck my head.

lines.zh: 我端着锅也照样走得稳。
lines.en: I can walk steadily even while carrying a pot.

lines.zh: 这条路有你的脚印，我踩着走。
lines.en: This road holds your footprints, and I step in them.

lines.zh: 我的步子比人类重，比恶魔轻。
lines.en: My steps are heavier than a human's, lighter than a demon's.

lines.zh: 我在数架子上的香料罐。
lines.en: I am counting the spice jars on the shelf.

lines.zh: 刀在磨石上走，声音很慢。
lines.en: The knife slides over the whetstone, slow and even.

lines.zh: 汤在锅里冒泡，我盯着它看。
lines.en: The soup bubbles in the pot, and I watch it.

lines.zh: 你出门时没关门，我听着风声。
lines.en: You left the door open; I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 我把围裙的结重新系了一遍。
lines.en: I retie the knot of my apron once more.

lines.zh: 角上落了灰，我抬手擦掉。
lines.en: Dust settled on my horns; I wipe it away.

lines.zh: 契约戒指在指上转了半圈。
lines.en: The pact ring turns half a circle on my finger.

lines.zh: 我在等你回来吃饭，虽然你不饿。
lines.en: I wait for you to come eat, though you are not hungry.

lines.zh: 火塘快灭了，我添了一块炭。
lines.en: The hearth is dying; I add a piece of coal.

lines.zh: 窗外有鸟叫，我考虑要不要烤它。
lines.en: A bird calls outside; I consider roasting it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴自己在地上打拍子。
lines.en: My tail taps a rhythm on the floor by itself.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太静，我哼了半句歌。
lines.en: The house is too quiet, so I hum half a song.

lines.zh: 我把碗摆成两副，一副给你。
lines.en: I set out two bowls, one of them for you.

lines.zh: 水缸见底了，我记着要去打水。
lines.en: The water barrel is low; I remind myself to refill it.

lines.zh: 我在窗边看雨，看了一会儿。
lines.en: I watch the rain a while by the window.

lines.zh: 炉子里的火，我拨了一下。
lines.en: I poke the fire in the stove.

lines.zh: 你回来了，我先把火拨旺。
lines.en: You are back; I will stir the fire up first.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，今天又添了新伤。
lines.en: I look at your hands; there are new cuts today.

lines.zh: 你别站在门口，风灌进来。
lines.en: Do not stand in the doorway; the wind gets in.

lines.zh: 你的脸色不对，是遇到什么了？
lines.en: Your face is off; did something happen?

lines.zh: 我等你先开口，你总是慢慢说。
lines.en: I wait for you to speak; you always take your time.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里照见自己的角。
lines.en: I see my own horns reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你今天走得很远，鞋底全是泥。
lines.en: You walked far today; your soles are all mud.

lines.zh: 别急着解释，先坐下。
lines.en: Do not rush to explain; sit down first.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块留给你了。
lines.en: I saved the best piece for you.

lines.zh: 你笑一下，我就知道没事了。
lines.en: Smile once, and I will know all is well.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的恶魔的气味。
lines.en: You carry the scent of another demon.

lines.zh: 我只在你面前收起爪子。
lines.en: I only retract my claws in front of you.

lines.zh: 你的头发乱了，我伸手理一下。
lines.en: Your hair is messy; I reach out to smooth it.

lines.zh: 看我做什么，锅里还没好。
lines.en: Why look at me? The pot is not ready yet.

lines.zh: 这点伤不算什么，你别慌。
lines.en: This wound is nothing; do not panic.

lines.zh: 我流血很慢，所以还站得住。
lines.en: I bleed slowly, so I can still stand.

lines.zh: 它砍在我肩上，骨头没断。
lines.en: It cut my shoulder, but the bone held.

lines.zh: 退后，血会烫到你。
lines.en: Back away; my blood will scald you.

lines.zh: 我疼，但不想让你看见。
lines.en: It hurts, but I would rather you did not see.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起契约的火。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the pact fire.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神看我，我没事。
lines.en: Do not look at me like that; I am fine.

lines.zh: 你先看看自己有没有受伤。
lines.en: First check whether you are hurt anywhere.

lines.zh: 我还能挥爪，就还能打。
lines.en: If I can still swing a claw, I can still fight.

lines.zh: 扶我一下，就一下。
lines.en: Steady me once, just once.

lines.zh: 生牛肉交给我，我会做得很好。
lines.en: Hand me the raw beef; I will do it justice.

lines.zh: 这袋面粉够烤一炉面包了。
lines.en: This bag of flour is enough for a batch of bread.

lines.zh: 你把食材举高，是在逗我。
lines.en: You hold the ingredients high just to tease me.

lines.zh: 蘑菇要先用黄油煎，才不腥。
lines.en: Mushrooms need butter first, or they taste of earth.

lines.zh: 那块生鱼，我闻到了河的味道。
lines.en: That raw fish smells of the river it came from.

lines.zh: 让我接手，这锅汤还有救。
lines.en: Let me take over; this soup can still be saved.

lines.zh: 手里这点盐，能决定一顿饭。
lines.en: The salt in my hand decides the whole meal.

lines.zh: 你带了可可豆？今晚可以甜一点。
lines.en: You brought cocoa beans? Tonight can be sweeter.

lines.zh: 生鸡肉有点麻烦，但我有耐心。
lines.en: Raw chicken is troublesome, but I have patience.

lines.zh: 我闻一下就知道该放什么。
lines.en: One sniff tells me exactly what it needs.

lines.zh: 灶台太窄，我们侧身过。
lines.en: The stove is narrow; let us pass sideways.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，撞上了木架。
lines.en: I step back and hit the wooden shelf.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我胸口，不疼。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my chest; it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 别在厨房里跑，锅是烫的。
lines.en: Do not run in the kitchen; the pot is hot.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绊了你，是它不听话。
lines.en: My tail tripped you; it does not listen.

lines.zh: 两个人挤在一起，盘子要掉了。
lines.en: Two of us crowded together; the plates will fall.

lines.zh: 角碰到门框，响了一声。
lines.en: My horns knock the doorframe with a crack.

lines.zh: 我让开，你过去吧。
lines.en: I will move aside; go on through.

lines.zh: 我们撞得碗都跳起来了。
lines.en: We bumped hard enough to make the bowls jump.

lines.zh: 站稳，别踩到炭火。
lines.en: Steady yourself; do not step into the coals.

lines.zh: 契约是我们唯一的婚礼。
lines.en: Our pact is the only wedding we have.

lines.zh: 戒指戴上了，我就不走了。
lines.en: The ring is on, so I am not leaving.

lines.zh: 人间的仪式我学过一点。
lines.en: I have learned a little of mortal ceremony.

lines.zh: 别问我以前的事，以前没有你。
lines.en: Do not ask about before; before, there was no you.

lines.zh: 我把名字刻在碗底，只有你能看见。
lines.en: I carved my name under the bowl where only you can see.

lines.zh: 这屋子小，足够两个人住。
lines.en: This house is small, enough for two.

lines.zh: 你睡着后，我守着门。
lines.en: After you fall asleep, I keep the door.

lines.zh: 我这一生只签这一次。
lines.en: I sign only once in this life.

lines.zh: 若你解除契约，我不会拦你。
lines.en: If you break the pact, I will not stop you.

lines.zh: 别叫我离开，我不擅长这个。
lines.en: Do not tell me to leave; I am not good at it.

lines.zh: 你把食物右键交给我，我记着。
lines.en: You right-click the food into my hands, and I remember.

lines.zh: 这袋种子我收进柜子了。
lines.en: I put this bag of seeds in the cupboard.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的面包，还能吃。
lines.en: Bread dropped on the ground can still be eaten.

lines.zh: 你的工具我来收，别乱放。
lines.en: I will put your tools away; do not leave them out.

lines.zh: 我捡起那枚硬币，放回你口袋。
lines.en: I pick up the coin and put it back in your pocket.

lines.zh: 这捆草料是给谁的？
lines.en: Who is this bundle of fodder for?

lines.zh: 锅铲我拿，你手上有伤。
lines.en: I will take the spatula; your hands are hurt.

lines.zh: 地上有水，我先把桶提走。
lines.en: There is water on the floor; I will move the bucket.

lines.zh: 我把食材分好，明天省事。
lines.en: I sort the ingredients so tomorrow is easier.

lines.zh: 这瓶药我替你收着。
lines.en: I will keep this potion safe for you.

lines.zh: 门口有人影，站得太久了。
lines.en: There is a figure at the door, standing too long.

lines.zh: 它们围过来时，我数了数。
lines.en: I counted them as they closed in.

lines.zh: 你的背后有脚步声，很轻。
lines.en: There are footsteps behind you, very light.

lines.zh: 这次来的不是客人。
lines.en: This one is not a guest.

lines.zh: 我把你往身后带了一步。
lines.en: I move you one step behind me.

lines.zh: 它们身上有铁锈和血的味道。
lines.en: They smell of rust and blood.

lines.zh: 我听见弓弦绷紧的声音。
lines.en: I hear a bowstring draw tight.

lines.zh: 火塘的光照不到那边。
lines.en: The hearth light does not reach over there.

lines.zh: 有一个绕到了侧面，我看见了。
lines.en: One has gone around the side; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你先别出声，让我听。
lines.en: Do not make a sound yet; let me listen.

lines.zh: 它们以为这屋子没有守卫。
lines.en: They think this house has no guard.

lines.zh: 我解下围裙，放在桌上。
lines.en: I untie my apron and lay it on the table.

lines.zh: 今晚的饭要晚一点了。
lines.en: Dinner will be a little late tonight.

lines.zh: 我把门闩上了，它们进不来。
lines.en: I barred the door; they cannot get in.

lines.zh: 我站在你和它中间，这很清楚。
lines.en: I stand between you and it; that is clear enough.

lines.zh: 爪子伸出来时，屋子会安静。
lines.en: When my claws come out, the room goes quiet.

lines.zh: 它再往前，我就先动手。
lines.en: If it takes one more step, I strike first.

lines.zh: 我的角低下来，是为了撞。
lines.en: My horns lower for one purpose: to ram.

lines.zh: 掌心这团火，够它记住。
lines.en: This fire in my palm will teach it a lesson.

lines.zh: 别从后面靠近我，我在等它。
lines.en: Do not come up behind me; I am waiting for it.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸乱了，它怕了。
lines.en: Its breathing has gone uneven; it is afraid.

lines.zh: 我给你三息时间躲开。
lines.en: I give you three breaths to get clear.

lines.zh: 这屋子是我打扫的，别弄脏。
lines.en: I clean this house; do not make a mess of it.

lines.zh: 它退到墙角，那就没得谈了。
lines.en: It backs into the corner, so there is nothing to discuss.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经僵成一条线。
lines.en: My tail has gone rigid as a line.

lines.zh: 等它扑过来，我再侧身。
lines.en: I will step aside when it lunges.

lines.zh: 你数到三就好，别数太快。
lines.en: Count to three, and not too quickly.

lines.zh: 今晚的汤，得等这一下结束。
lines.en: Tonight's soup must wait for this to end.

lines.zh: 别急，我先看看它有几只手。
lines.en: Patience. Let me count its hands.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，它的甲裂了。
lines.en: One claw stroke and its armor splits.

lines.zh: 我用手背打它，省得洗爪子。
lines.en: I strike with the back of my hand to save washing my claws.

lines.zh: 火从掌心推出去，很近。
lines.en: Fire leaves my palm from very close range.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的角，我把它甩开。
lines.en: It grabs my horns; I throw it off.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了你手上的伤。
lines.en: This blow is for the wound on your hand.

lines.zh: 我打得很轻，怕弄坏地板。
lines.en: I hit lightly, afraid of damaging the floor.

lines.zh: 它倒下去时，我扶了一下桌子。
lines.en: As it falls, I steady the table.

lines.zh: 角顶进它的胸口，拔出来有点费劲。
lines.en: My horns sink into its chest and pull out slowly.

lines.zh: 我数过它的骨头，比想的少。
lines.en: I counted its bones; fewer than I expected.

lines.zh: 别过来，血会溅到你身上。
lines.en: Stay back; the blood will splash on you.

lines.zh: 契约签下的那一刻，我就在了。
lines.en: The moment the pact was signed, I was here.

lines.zh: 烟散开，我先看见的是你的手。
lines.en: The smoke clears and the first thing I see is your hand.

lines.zh: 我从火里走出来，礼服没烧着。
lines.en: I walk out of the fire and my coat is unburnt.

lines.zh: 这具身体是按你的愿望捏的。
lines.en: This body was shaped according to your wish.

lines.zh: 地上还有粉笔灰，我踩到了。
lines.en: Chalk dust is still on the floor, and I stepped in it.

lines.zh: 我来的路上听见很多声音。
lines.en: On my way here I heard many voices.

lines.zh: 第一次站在这间屋子里，很矮。
lines.en: Standing in this room for the first time, it feels low.

lines.zh: 我叫了你的名字，你答应了。
lines.en: I called your name, and you answered.

lines.zh: 从今天起，火由我来看。
lines.en: From today, I will tend the fire.

lines.zh: 别怕我的角，它不伤人。
lines.en: Do not fear my horns; they harm no one.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在墙上，比你的大。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the wall, larger than yours.

lines.zh: 这屋里没有锅，我有点失望。
lines.en: There is no pot in this house; I am a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 契约的墨还没干，我闻得到。
lines.en: The ink on the pact is still wet; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我来了，你以后不用一个人吃饭。
lines.en: I am here; you need not eat alone anymore.

lines.zh: 火不烧我，但这一下很烫。
lines.en: Fire does not burn me, but this one is hot.

lines.zh: 落地时我护住了头，角没事。
lines.en: I shielded my head as I landed; my horns are fine.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我的火灭了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and my fire goes out.

lines.zh: 气浪把桌子掀了，我的汤。
lines.en: The blast upends the table; my soup.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肋骨之间，很碍事。
lines.en: The arrow is wedged between my ribs, in the way.

lines.zh: 这种咒文，我认得几个字。
lines.en: I recognize a few words of that incantation.

lines.zh: 我做饭给别人，自己忘了吃。
lines.en: I cook for others and forget to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，麻到了牙。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and numbs me to the teeth.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我还在想那锅汤。
lines.en: As I fall, I am still thinking about that soup.
